---
name: Change proposal
about: Propose a scoped non-sensitive change and identify evidence and decision gates
title: ''
---

## Problem and intended behavior

Explain the concrete need and affected repository/source. Keep confidential
findings in the affected repository's verified private reporting channel.

## Scope and existing work

Identify relevant specification/vector, contract, dependency, configuration and
repository boundaries. Link overlapping non-sensitive work when available.

## Decisions and acceptance evidence

State the required reviewer/approver roles, unresolved ownership or compatibility
questions and evidence that would prove the intended result. Distinguish proposed
behavior from implementation, historical results and actual operation.

## Cost and remaining gates

Describe meaningful qualification, bounded resource needs and independent review.
State any release, custody, deployment, economic or activation decision separately.
Use English and omit personal identities, private paths, credentials, signing
material, account inventories and raw operator diagnostics.
